protocol.selection: T5 epoch: lowest validation target-token NLL; decoding: highest validation ROUGE-L, tie -> fewer beams. GPT-2 unchanged.
protocol.fresh_test: 512 new corrected-experiment rows; exclude all prior train/validation/test and legacy pilot; exact and 5-word Jaccard >=0.8 exclusions on visible text
protocol.detail_review: 24 hash-selected fresh-test rows, two source-supported product facts each labeled before predictions; agent-authored, not independent human evaluation
limitations: Only Text/Summary retained: no product IDs or product-disjoint guarantee.

Lexical near-duplicate filter does not guarantee semantic independence.
